name: practice mode
definition_zh: 学生在指导或提示下进行实验操作和训练的虚拟教学模式。
usage_note: 正文区别练习与考核两种工作模式，练习模式不直接按操作结果评分。
usage_overview: 用于虚拟实验教学中的操作训练，学生可在指导或提示下练习，系统记录操作过程，但不直接按操作结果评分，以此区别于考核模式。

complete_examples.text: The practice mode means that students carry out various training, experimental operations or simulation measurements under guidance or reminders, for the software will not give scores for experimental operation results, but based on the background management, it can record user operations, online time, etc.
